pmKisan.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
pmKisan.description: Direct income support for eligible small and marginal farmers to support crop cultivation and household needs.
pmKisan.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments
pmKisan.eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable land holdings.
howToApply: Visit the PM-KISAN portal or your nearest Common Service Centre.
Submit your bank account details and application.
Track the application status using your registration number.
